input.query: The mobile phone swipe navigation moves up or down instead of left or right after downloading an app.
input.siis_response:
Swipe gestures or navigation buttons behave unexpectedly

Some apps can change how navigation gestures respond, or the navigation type may have been changed. You can choose between navigation buttons and swipe gestures in the navigation bar settings.

1. Change the navigation type
Open Settings and tap Display. Tap Navigation bar, and then select your preferred navigation type between Buttons and Swipe gestures. If you use swipe gestures, you can also turn on Gesture hint to show guidance lines at the bottom of the screen.

Once the navigation type is set, gestures work the same way in most apps.
